say:3:1141105001:1.text: Speaking of food, the wanderfruit growing in the desert is quite tasty... Lumont, what do you like to eat?
say:3:1141105001:1.source_cn: 说到吃的话，沙漠里的旅人树果还不错……噜噜呢？有爱吃的...

say:4:1141105002:1.text: Me? Hmm... I have lots, but nothing is coming to mind right now...
say:4:1141105002:1.source_cn: 什么？我？唔……喜欢吃的特别多，但一时间脑子想不起来几个了。

say:5:1141105003:1.text: It happens to me a lot. I get a strong desire to eat but can't figure out what I'm craving...
say:5:1141105003:1.source_cn: 我经常会有这种时候，就是特别想吃点什么来解馋，但就是没...

say:6:1141105004:1.text: Sometimes I just grab whatever I can get my hands on, which turns out not to be satisfying at all.
say:6:1141105004:1.source_cn: 呼，有时候着急决定，结果吃到嘴里的时候也根本没什么满足感。

choice_prompt:7:1141105004.text: Sometimes I just grab whatever I can get my hands on, which turns out not to be satisfying at all.
choice_prompt:7:1141105004.source_cn: 呼，有时候着急决定，结果吃到嘴里的时候也根本没什么满足感。

say:8:1141105005:1.text: Ah! It's great that you understand the importance of good food!
say:8:1141105005:1.source_cn: 啊，你能明白我说的真是太好了！

say:9:1141105007:1.text: I treat myself to something nice after each brawl. And good eats are as simple as it gets for me.
say:9:1141105007:1.source_cn: 每次战斗后，我都会好好犒劳自己，好吃的对噜噜来说就是最...

say:10:1141105008:1.text: Magister, maybe we should suggest Lumont try some food from other regions?
say:10:1141105008:1.source_cn: 主人，也许我们可以推荐噜噜点其他区域的美食？
say:10:1141105008:1.male: Magister, maybe we should suggest Lumont try some food from other regions?
say:10:1141105008:1.female: Magister, maybe we should suggest Lumont try some food from other regions?

choice_prompt:11:1141105008.text: Magister, maybe we should suggest Lumont try some food from other regions?
choice_prompt:11:1141105008.source_cn: 主人，也许我们可以推荐噜噜点其他区域的美食？
choice_prompt:11:1141105008.male: Magister, maybe we should suggest Lumont try some food from other regions?
choice_prompt:11:1141105008.female: Magister, maybe we should suggest Lumont try some food from other regions?

say:12:1141105009:1.text: Berries from the Lightbearer Empire? What do they taste like?
say:12:1141105009:1.source_cn: 耀光的浆果？是什么口感的？会是软软的吗？

say:13:1141105010:1.text: Mmm... The taste... It's soft and chewy with a hint of bitterness.
say:13:1141105010:1.source_cn: 唔……看起来有一丢丢黄，但通体还是晶莹剔透的。不过味道...

say:14:1141105011:1.source_cn: 噜噜还是更喜欢吃甜的果子。

say:16:1141105012:1.text: The Dark Forest... I've never heard of this place.
say:16:1141105012:1.source_cn: 薄暮丛林……噜噜没怎么听说过这个地方。

say:17:1141105013:1.text: It's very different from the Ashen Wastes. There are so many trees and plants that one can barely see the sky.
say:17:1141105013:1.source_cn: 是与荒角沙漠完全不同的地方，植被丰富到看不见天空。

say:18:1141105014:0.text: I recommend an iced lemon balm water with freshly squeezed ivy juice.
say:18:1141105014:0.source_cn: 要推荐的是一种以柠香波子水为主料的冰镇饮，加入鲜榨的虹...

say:19:1141105015:1.text: Sounds delicious... I'd love to try!
say:19:1141105015:1.source_cn: 冰镇饮，感觉很好喝……噜噜有机会一定要尝试下！

choice:11:1:2.text: Or drinks from the Dark Forest?
choice:11:1:2.male: Or drinks from the Dark Forest?
choice:11:1:2.female: Or drinks from the Dark Forest?

say:20:1141105006:1.text: I envy you, really... It's been a while since food brought me a sense of satisfaction.
say:20:1141105006:1.source_cn: 真羡慕你呀……吃东西很满足这件事已经很久都没有享受过了。

choice:7:1:2.text: Well, I'm not a picky eater.
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 我吃什么都觉得很满足
choice:7:1:2.male: Well, I'm not a picky eater.
choice:7:1:2.female: Well, I'm not a picky eater.
